messages:
Sam: heads up — noticed a slow memory creep on dedicated int8 pools when running long-context (~30k tokens) replay traces. looks like KV slab fragmentation + frequent warm-reclaiming of small pages.

Anya: hmm. is this new after the int8 kernel change earlier this week? :thinking_face:

Sam: yes, rolled int8 microkernel v2 on thurs. perf looked fine on short traces, but longctx production runs show sustained +1.8GB over 90m. heap maps show many 4k slabs in use but >40% are partially empty.

Mike: can you paste the pmap / slabstat snapshot? also wanted to see eviction telemetry (slot residency histogram).

Sam: pasted below — trimmed:
```
# slabstats @ 2026-03-10 14:05
total_slabs: 23456
4k_slots: 128k used: 87k free_frag: 0.42
8k_slots: 32k used: 30k free_frag: 0.06
slot_fill_pct (median): 0.58
hotset_evictions/sec: 23
warm_reclaim_rate: 0.37
```

Sam: eviction traces show repeated warm-wakeup of same 4k slot addresses, often followed by tiny writes that keep them partially filled. pattern suggests our coalescing is less effective under int8 alignment (8-byte vs 16-byte?)

Irene: interesting — could be kernel selection changed packing/padding for KV layout. int8 path uses a different MatMul kernel that aligns KV blocks to 8-byte boundaries; bf16 path used 16. that affects how we pack slots into slabs.

benchbot: perf snapshot attached (summary):
- throughput: stable
- p99 latency: +3% under longctx
- memory: +1.8GB over baseline (steady climb)

Anya: ok let's try two quick experiments — (A) force int8 codepath to use previous allocator alignment (set ENV KV_SLAB_ALIGN=16) (B) disable small-slot coalescing for 4k pages. can someone run both on a repro job?

Mike: running A now on a canary. command: `KV_SLAB_ALIGN=16 ./run_repro.sh --trace longctx_30k --quant int8`

Sam: ran B locally, short run (~15m). memory plateaued instead of climbing. fragmentation metric (free_frag) improved to 0.22. not perfect but better.

Irene: suggests alignment change matters. but B disables coalescing which could hurt hit-rate. do we have quality diff for int8 when coalescing off?

Sam: quick eval on 500 prompts: rouge/emd delta < 0.2% — noise level. but need larger eval set.

Anya: next step: instrument kernel selection trace + allocator events to correlate: when kernel X chosen, log slab alloc pattern for that request. small patch: add TRACE_ALGO selection id to kv_alloc event. will push in 5m.

Mike: also seeing repeated single-slot evicts that look like singleflight contention in batching heuristic — when batch size == 1 we allocate small slots often. could be interplay: batching -> small KV writes -> fragmentation.

Irene: kernel fallback logic currently picks int8-matmul-v2 for sequences < 2048? maybe it's reversed in some dynamic cases. if kernel flips mid-session, KV layout flips too. we should avoid switching allocator alignment mid-pool. either pin alignment per pool or force a compaction on kernel flip.

Sam: filed quick issue: https://redwood/infra/issue/INFR-4721 (notes + slabstats).

Anya: pushed TRACE_ALGO branch to staging. bench job queued with `--trace longctx_30k --iters 4`. I'll grab allocator logs.

benchbot: staging job started (job id j-8842). will update when complete.

Mike: for repro folks: minimal repro script I used
```
python repro_longctx.py --model redwood-open-int8 --seed 42 --tokens 30000 --batch 1 --enable-quant
```
outputs: per-iter slab allocations (json) to /tmp/kvtrace.json

Sam: attached tail of /tmp/kvtrace.json — lots of recurring 4k allocations on same addr ranges, with alignment=8.

Irene: if staging trace shows correlation, we should: 1) pin allocator alignment per pool, 2) add opportunistic compaction when fragmentation > 0.35, 3) revisit kernel selection boundaries.

Anya: staging finished. quick summary: when TRACE_ALGO=int8-v2 we see 0.40 median free_frag; when forced ALIGN=16 frag -> 0.21. also kernel flip events correspond to abrupt allocator pattern changes within same process.

Mike: that nails it. plan: rollback int8 kernel auto-switch in runtime (hotfix) and ship allocator pin + compaction in next minor. I'll open PR for hotfix and add metrics dashboard for slab_frag and kernel_id.

Sam: PR review pinged: https://redwood/infra/pull/2893 — hotfix sets KV_SLAB_ALIGN=16 for existing pools until allocator patch ships.

Irene: add automated check to rollout: when enabling new matmul kernels, run smalllongctx smoke that checks frag growth < 0.05 over 30m. put in Canary gating.

Anya: adding to rollout checklist. also let's run a longer eval of accuracy with alignment change to be safe.

deploybot: Canary deploy applied to 10% of int8 pools with hotfix env; monitoring for 1h.

Sam: thanks all. follow-ups: (1) Anya run full accuracy sweep (2) Mike merge hotfix if no regressions (3) Irene draft kernel-selection safe-guards. will post outcomes here. :thumbsup:
